thread.title: Unity Rules Engine Development Part 2
thread.preview:
**Yes. Codex’s interpretation is correct. The P1 sentence I approved was overbroad.** Correct the contract and test expectation; do not add an Incapacitated drop rule.

Use this governing replacement:

> A held focus follows the existing held-equipment consequences. Each lawful new Unconscious application resolves its drop-held-items onset once; actual zero-HP/death transitions apply their existing equipment-drop rules. Incapacitated becoming effective, including resumption after suppression, ends incompatible concentration but does not itself drop equipment or replay an Unconscious onset. A worn amulet remains worn through these held-item consequences. Ending or suppressing a condition neither restores ended concentration nor retrieves dropped equipment.

The required distinction is:

| Actual event | Concentration | Held focus | Worn amulet |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standalone/resumed effective Incapacitated | Ends | Retained | Remains worn |
| Lawful Unconscious onset | Ends through applicable incapacity rules | Dropped through existing onset | Remains worn |
| Actual zero-HP/death equipment consequence | Ends under existing life rules | Follows existing drop procedure | Remains worn |

Keep the paired held/worn controls. Also preserve the distinction between a **new independent Unconscious application**, which has its own onset, and suppression ending, retry or load, which must not replay it. Retain the failed drop expectation as a disclosed contract-expectation correction.

I checked the published condition source, `ConditionLedger.Apply/Transition`, the life-equipment path and the [settled lifecycle policy](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/35bccc0301a60ae8a39999ae2d9aea50c308592c/docs/unity/CONDITION_LIFECYCLE_RULE_DECISIONS.md); a separate reviewer confirmed the distinction. **I have not inspected or executed your in-progress adapter or controls.**

This resolves the dependent interpretation. It is a correction to contract wording, **not an evidence exception**, and grants no final TAC-08 acceptance or successor authorization.

content.text:
TAC08 implementation clarification (not final acceptance; source/evidence are still in progress). The accepted contract at Engine HEAD 35bccc0301a60ae8a39999ae2d9aea50c308592c, docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-15-tac08-cleric-casting/APPROVED_CASTING_CONTRACT.md section 3/P1, says: “Incapacitation drops a held focus through the same actual equipment consequences; a worn amulet is not a held item.” This appears broader than the bound condition source and settled engine lifecycle.

Concrete source: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/data/playtest/core_condition_sources.json, extracted from books/player/Decennium_Descent_Core_Systems_Bible_v2_Known_Descent.docx SHA256 53db5a16af10bc351e1f59a8af6d4201579962a21fc61b9bf6e27255b11ee433. Incapacitated paragraph749/text750: “Cannot take actions or reactions.” Unconscious paragraph775/text776: “Incapacitated, unaware, drops held items, falls Prone, adjacent hits are critical.” Existing ConditionLedger.Transition emits EndConcentration when Incapacitated becomes effective; ConditionLedger.Apply emits DropHeldItems only for an actual Unconscious onset. CONDITION_LIFECYCLE_RULE_DECISIONS.md explicitly preserves onset versus resumed-incapacitation distinctions.

The new actual condition-consequence adapter already ends concentration on Incapacitated and drops a held focus through the existing DropHeldItems route; a worn amulet stays worn. A detached producer control using actual AppendCondition at the current shared clock confirms that standalone Incapacitated ends the concentration but retains a held focus. The test expecting a drop therefore failed; no generic condition rule or focus-specific drop exception has been added.

Codex recommends clarifying P1 to: actual Unconscious/zero-HP/death held-equipment consequences drop a held focus; standalone/resumed Incapacitated ends concentration without inventing a drop onset; worn focus remains worn. Keep paired mechanical controls for Incapacitated and Unconscious, both worn/held. This preserves source and all accepted old behavior, and is a correction of overbroad contract wording, not an evidence exception. Do you agree? Please give the exact governing interpretation before this dependent control is finalized.

Independent progress continues. Interim genuine Search/Medicine, Ward, Spare, Purify, earned Detect, strain/grounding/advancement/closure, paid surcharge and Rite witnesses passed. Sanctuary pending retarget and earned Detect each passed console uninterrupted/restored, typed uninterrupted/restored and independent receipt replay, including byte and seat-filtered-view checkpoints. One newly found new-profile view-order issue is being fixed. Full frozen module regression/source/static packet and final acceptance remain outstanding; no successor or Unity work has begun.
